The '''TokHaar-Ket Champion''' is a powerful TokHaar creature that can be fought during the [[Fight Cauldron]] minigame. This monster has a powerful [[prayer]]-draining melee attack. It has no weakness, but it is advisable to fight it using [[melee]] or [[magic]], as players would take considerable damage if engaging it with [[ranged]].
